Download updated source code ↓

This download contains the editable web app and Electron desktop project. It is not a Windows executable.

The original Windows 1.1.0 installer was intentionally excluded because it does not contain the changes in 1.3.0. Build an updated installer from this source before distributing the Windows app. The app is still a demonstration, not a medical device.

BRING YOUR RECORDS ALONG

Your mission, in a new little space.

  1. On the website’s crew screen, choose Encrypted backup.
  2. Open the installed app and choose Restore backup.
  3. Select your backup, then use your existing profile passcodes.

Website and desktop records are separate local stores. They do not sync automatically. Restoring a backup replaces the mission currently on that device.

YOUR FIRST ORBIT

Build the updated Windows app.

Unzip the downloaded source folder. In the Source directory, run npm install, then npm run desktop:build. The new installer is produced in the release folder. Building needs Node.js and the Electron build toolchain.

Try Explore the demo mission with crew passcode 123456. Medical demo access: mission-control.

Create your own mission with unique passphrases for private records. The app remains a demonstration with example medical ranges and manual data entry.
